section_summary.extract_value: This section details the assessment of personality using the Big-Five Structure Inventory (BFSI), developed by Arendasy, Sommer, & Feldhammer (2011). The BFSI measures the Big Five personality dimensions, each with six facets, totaling 30 facets assessed by ten items each. The instrument is IRT-based, shows good correlations with the German NEO-PI-R, and has high internal consistency.
